faqs.question: What is the Pitching Module?
faqs.answer: The Pitching Module enables eligible entrepreneurs to complete the pitching process by completing verification requirements, submitting Business Plan Documents and Seed Capital Documents, and responding to resubmission requests where applicable.

faqs.question: Who can access the Pitching Module?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneurs who have completed the required LMS requirements and meet the applicable programme conditions can access the Pitching Module.

faqs.question: When can I access the Pitching Module?
faqs.answer: You can access the Pitching Module after completing the LMS requirement, subject to the applicable programme conditions.

faqs.question: Why can't I see the Pitching Module?
faqs.answer: Access depends on completion of the required LMS requirement and applicable programme conditions. Use the support option available on the platform or contact TEF support for technical issues.

faqs.question: What are the main stages of the Pitching Module?
faqs.answer: The main stages are Identity Verification, Pitching Agreement acceptance, OTP verification, Window A – Business Plan, Window B – Seed Capital, review, and resubmission where required.

faqs.question: Do I need to complete the stages in a particular order?
faqs.answer: Yes. You must complete the required access and verification steps first, then complete Window A – Business Plan before proceeding to Window B – Seed Capital.

faqs.question: Do I need to complete the entire Pitching process myself?
faqs.answer: You are responsible for completing the required verification, document submissions, and resubmissions. The review and administrative activities are handled through the programme's designated process.

sections.section: B. Access, Identity Verification and Agreement

faqs.question: What do I need to do before starting the Pitching process?
faqs.answer: You must complete the LMS requirement, access the Pitching Module, complete Identity Verification, accept the Pitching Agreement, and complete OTP verification.

faqs.question: What is Identity Verification?
faqs.answer: Identity Verification is a mandatory step that must be completed before proceeding with the Pitching Module.

faqs.question: When do I complete Identity Verification?
faqs.answer: Identity Verification is completed after accessing the Pitching Module and before proceeding with the pitching activities.

faqs.question: What is the Pitching Agreement?
faqs.answer: The Pitching Agreement is an agreement that you must accept before proceeding with the pitching process.

faqs.question: Is accepting the Pitching Agreement mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Acceptance of the Pitching Agreement is required before proceeding.

faqs.question: What happens after I accept the Pitching Agreement?
faqs.answer: OTP verification follows Pitching Agreement acceptance.

faqs.question: What is OTP verification?
faqs.answer: OTP verification is a required verification step that must be completed after accepting the Pitching Agreement.

faqs.question: Can I proceed without completing OTP verification?
faqs.answer: No. OTP verification is part of the required access sequence before proceeding with pitching.

faqs.question: In which languages is the Pitching Agreement available?
faqs.answer: The SRS states that the agreement is configured in four preferred languages which are Arabic, English, French and Portuguese.

faqs.question: What happens if my Identity Card has expired?
faqs.answer: If the uploaded Identity Card has expired, you must upload a new Identity Card.

faqs.question: Can I upload a new Identity Card when my existing one expires?
faqs.answer: Yes. The system allows a new Identity Card to be uploaded when the existing Identity Card has expired.

faqs.question: Will my previous Identity Card be deleted after uploading a new one?
faqs.answer: No. The previous and updated Identity Cards are retained in your profile.

faqs.question: Will both my old and new Identity Cards remain available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both the previous and updated Identity Cards are retained in your profile.

faqs.question: What happens if I do not update my expired Identity Card?
faqs.answer: The expired Identity card must be updated. If the entrepreneur does not update the card, there can be an issue in the identity verification.

faqs.question: What is Window A?
faqs.answer: Window A is the Business Plan Document Phase of the Pitching Module.

faqs.question: What do I need to do in Window A?
faqs.answer: You must complete the Business Plan Document Phase, upload the required Business Plan Documents, and submit the Business Plan.

faqs.question: What documents do I need to submit in Window A?
faqs.answer: You must upload the required Business Plan Documents configured for the programme. The documents required are mentioned in the section of Window A. Once you open the business plan document phase, you can view the different types of documents required.

faqs.question: Can I proceed to Window B before completing Window A?
faqs.answer: No. The Business Plan Document Phase must be completed before you can fill the Seed Capital Documents.

faqs.question: Do I need to submit the Business Plan after uploading the documents?
faqs.answer: The submitting of documents is the part of the business plan document phase.

faqs.question: What happens after I submit my Business Plan?
faqs.answer: The Business Plan enters the applicable review process.

faqs.question: Can I edit my Business Plan after submitting it?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot edit the document once submitted. However, you can reupload the documents and resubmit them when resubmission is requested from the admin’s end.

faqs.question: Can I submit my Business Plan multiple times on my own?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot submit the business plan multiple times on your own. Further submission is addressed through the defined resubmission process.

faqs.question: What is Window B?
faqs.answer: Window B is the Seed Capital Document Phase of the Pitching Module.

faqs.question: When can I access Window B?
faqs.answer: You can fill the Seed Capital Documents after completing the Business Plan Document Phase.

faqs.question: What do I need to do in Window B?
faqs.answer: You must upload the required Seed Capital Documents and submit them.

faqs.question: Can I fill Seed Capital Documents before completing the Business Plan?
faqs.answer: No. The Business Plan Document Phase must be completed first.

faqs.question: Do I need to make a separate final submission after submitting Seed Capital Documents?
faqs.answer: No. Seed Capital review starts after submission without requiring a separate final submission.

faqs.question: What happens after I submit my Seed Capital Documents?
faqs.answer: The Seed Capital Documents are taken into the applicable review process.

faqs.question: Does submitting Seed Capital mean that my documents are approved?
faqs.answer: No. Submission starts the review process; it does not mean automatic approval.

faqs.question: Can I edit or replace Seed Capital Documents after submission?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot edit the document once submitted. However, you can reupload the documents and resubmit them when resubmission is requested from the admin’s end.

faqs.question: What happens after I submit my Business Plan?
faqs.answer: Your Business Plan goes through the applicable review process. You may receive approval feedback or a resubmission request where applicable.

faqs.question: What happens after I submit my Seed Capital Documents?
faqs.answer: Your Seed Capital Documents go through the designated review process.

faqs.question: Who reviews my Business Plan?
faqs.answer: The Business Plan is reviewed through the designated external review process.

faqs.question: Who reviews my Seed Capital Documents?
faqs.answer: Seed Capital Documents are reviewed by the assigned Intern.

faqs.question: Can I choose my Business Plan reviewer?
faqs.answer: No entrepreneur-side reviewer selection is allowed.

faqs.question: Can I choose my Seed Capital reviewer?
faqs.answer: No entrepreneur-side reviewer selection is allowed.

faqs.question: Do I need to contact the reviewer after submitting my documents?
faqs.answer: No such entrepreneur-side action is allowed.

faqs.question: Can I see the complete internal review process?
faqs.answer: No, the entrepreneur cannot see the internal review process.

faqs.question: Can my Business Plan be reviewed again?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Business Plan may be sent for re-review through the applicable review process.

faqs.question: Does re-review mean that I must resubmit my documents?
faqs.answer: No. Internal re-review and entrepreneur resubmission are separate processes.

faqs.question: Can Window A and Window B be reviewed at the same time?
faqs.answer: Yes. Although Window A must be completed before Window B, the review processes for both windows can operate independently and in parallel after their respective submissions.

faqs.question: Why might I be asked to resubmit my Business Plan?
faqs.answer: A Business Plan resubmission may be requested based on the applicable review outcome, including a Poor Grade outcome.

faqs.question: How will I know that my Business Plan needs to be resubmitted?
faqs.answer: You will receive an email or notification informing you that your Business Plan must be resubmitted.

faqs.question: What information will I receive in the Business Plan resubmission notification?
faqs.answer: The notification contains the applicable resubmission reason, TEF Admin/Super Admin remarks or feedback, and the resubmission deadline.

faqs.question: Where can I find the reason for resubmission?
faqs.answer: The reason is provided in the Business Plan resubmission email or notification.

faqs.question: Where can I find the corrections, I need to make?
faqs.answer: The required corrections or guidance are provided through the applicable remarks or feedback.

faqs.question: Do I need to resubmit the entire Business Plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. You must resubmit the complete set of Business Plan Documents requested by TEF Admin.

faqs.question: Can I resubmit only one Business Plan document?
faqs.answer: No. Individual-document selection is not provided for entrepreneur Business Plan resubmission.

faqs.question: What if only one Business Plan document needs correction?
faqs.answer: You must still resubmit the complete requested Business Plan document set.

faqs.question: Can I ignore documents that were not specifically mentioned in the feedback?
faqs.answer: No. The required resubmission consists of the complete requested Business Plan document set.

faqs.question: Do I need to wait for another instruction before starting resubmission?
faqs.answer: No, once you receive the notification and email, you must start the resubmission process.

faqs.question: What happens after I resubmit my Business Plan?
faqs.answer: The resubmitted Business Plan goes through the complete applicable external review cycle again.

faqs.question: Will my resubmitted Business Plan be reviewed again?
faqs.answer: Yes. The complete applicable review cycle is followed again.

faqs.question: Can my Business Plan be requested for resubmission again?
faqs.answer: Yes, business plan can be requested for resubmission again.

faqs.question: What happens after the resubmitted Business Plan is reviewed?
faqs.answer: It is returned to the applicable administrative review process for further action, which may include approval or another internal review.

faqs.question: Why might I be asked to resubmit my Seed Capital Documents?
faqs.answer: You may be asked to resubmit Seed Capital Documents when the Intern identifies documents requiring correction.

faqs.question: How will I know that Seed Capital resubmission is required?
faqs.answer: You will receive the applicable notification or email.

faqs.question: What information is included in the Seed Capital resubmission notification?
faqs.answer: The notification contains the documents requiring resubmission, resubmission remarks, and the resubmission deadline.

faqs.question: Do I need to resubmit all Seed Capital Documents?
faqs.answer: No. You need to resubmit only the specific Seed Capital Documents identified for correction.

faqs.question: Can I select only the documents that need correction?
faqs.answer: Yes. Seed Capital resubmission allows selection of the documents requiring correction.

faqs.question: What should I do after receiving Seed Capital resubmission remarks?
faqs.answer: Review the identified documents and remarks, make the required corrections, and resubmit the requested documents within the applicable deadline.

faqs.question: Who reviews my resubmitted Seed Capital Documents?
faqs.answer: The same Intern reviews the resubmitted Seed Capital Documents.

faqs.question: Can I be asked to resubmit Seed Capital Documents again?
faqs.answer: Yes. Further Seed Capital resubmission may be requested until the configured resubmission deadline expires.

faqs.question: What happens if the Intern requests further corrections?
faqs.answer: You may receive another resubmission request and must resubmit the identified documents within the applicable deadline.

faqs.question: Do I need to resubmit documents that were not selected for correction?
faqs.answer: No. Only the requested Seed Capital Documents need to be resubmitted.

faqs.question: Do I have a deadline to complete the Pitching Module?
faqs.answer: Yes. The applicable Business Plan and Seed Capital timelines are configured for the programme.

faqs.question: Where can I find my resubmission deadline?
faqs.answer: The applicable resubmission deadline is communicated through the resubmission email or notification.

faqs.question: Do I have to complete resubmission within the communicated deadline?
faqs.answer: Yes. Resubmission is permitted until the configured deadline expires.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss the resubmission deadline?
faqs.answer: No further resubmission action is available after the deadline expires, unless the applicable deadline has been extended before expiry.

faqs.question: Can the Seed Capital resubmission deadline be extended?
faqs.answer: Yes. An existing Seed Capital resubmission deadline may be extended by the authorized role where applicable.

faqs.question: How will I know if my Seed Capital deadline has been extended?
faqs.answer: You will receive a notification or email containing the updated resubmission deadline.

faqs.question: Can I request an extension myself?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot request resubmission from your end as of now.

faqs.question: Can I continue resubmitting Seed Capital Documents until the deadline?
faqs.answer: Yes. Further resubmission may be requested until the configured deadline expires.

faqs.question: Is the Business Plan resubmission deadline the same as the Seed Capital resubmission deadline?
faqs.answer: They can be same, but they can also differ, as they are configured by different user roles.

faqs.question: What happens if I fail to complete the required activities within the programme timeline?
faqs.answer: Entrepreneurs who fail to complete the required activities within the configured programme timeline are automatically removed from the programme.

faqs.question: Can I submit after the programme deadline has expired?
faqs.answer: The required activities must be completed within the configured programme timeline.

faqs.question: Will I receive a notification if my Business Plan needs resubmission?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected entrepreneurs receive an email informing them that their Business Plan must be resubmitted.

faqs.question: Will the Business Plan resubmission email include the reason?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes the applicable resubmission reason.

faqs.question: Will the Business Plan resubmission email include feedback?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes the applicable TEF Admin/Super Admin remarks or feedback.

faqs.question: Will the Business Plan resubmission email include a deadline?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes the resubmission deadline.

faqs.question: Will I receive a notification if Seed Capital resubmission is required?
faqs.answer: Yes. The applicable notification contains the required resubmission details.

faqs.question: Will the Seed Capital notification identify the documents I need to correct?
faqs.answer: Yes. It identifies the documents requiring resubmission.

faqs.question: Will I receive an updated notification if my Seed Capital deadline is extended?
faqs.answer: Yes. The updated deadline is communicated through notification or email.

faqs.question: Will I receive feedback when my Business Plan is approved?
faqs.answer: Selected entrepreneurs receive an email containing the feedback provided by TEF Admin on approval of the Business Plan Document.

faqs.question: What should I do if I do not receive a notification?
faqs.answer: Use the support option available on the platform or contact TEF support for technical issues.

faqs.question: Can I track the progress of my Pitching application?
faqs.answer: The Pitching Module includes pitching status monitoring.

faqs.question: What does application status help me understand?
faqs.answer: It helps indicate the current stage of your pitching application.

faqs.question: Can I see whether my Business Plan is under review?
faqs.answer: No, not the entire process, however once the review is complete you will get the notification.

faqs.question: Can I see whether my Seed Capital Documents have been reviewed?
faqs.answer: Once the seed capital documents have been reviewed, the entrepreneur receives an email or the notification.

faqs.question: Why is my application still under review?
faqs.answer: Application is still under review as your submission may still be going through the applicable review process.

faqs.question: Does “submitted” mean that my application has been approved?
faqs.answer: No. Submission means that the required documents have been submitted. Approval is a separate stage in the review process.

faqs.question: Does submitting Seed Capital mean that it is automatically approved?
faqs.answer: No. Submission starts the Seed Capital review process; it does not mean automatic approval.

faqs.question: Can I contact the reviewer to ask about a delay?
faqs.answer: No entrepreneur cannot connect with the reviewer.

sections.section: L. Business Plan Approval and Pitching Completion

faqs.question: What happens when my Business Plan is finally approved?
faqs.answer: Once the Business Plan is finally approved by TEF Admin, no further Business Plan re-review or resubmission is applicable.

faqs.question: Can I be asked to resubmit my Business Plan after final approval?
faqs.answer: No. Once final approval is provided, no further Business Plan re-review or resubmission applies.

faqs.question: Will I receive feedback after Business Plan approval?
faqs.answer: Selected entrepreneurs receive an email containing the feedback provided by TEF Admin on approval of the Business Plan Document.

faqs.question: Does Business Plan approval mean that the entire Pitching process is complete?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Window B – Seed Capital and its applicable review process may still be relevant depending on your progress.

faqs.question: Does Seed Capital approval automatically mean I have been moved to Audit?
faqs.answer: No. Movement from Pitching to Audit is controlled through the administrative process.

faqs.question: Do I need to manually move myself to Audit?
faqs.answer: No. The Pitching-to-Audit movement is an administrative function.

faqs.question: How do I know that my entire Pitching process is complete?
faqs.answer: The pitching from your end is completed when you have submitted or resubmitted the documents. Once the submitted or resubmitted documents have finally been approved, the action for moving the entrepreneur from pitching to audit is initiated which marks the end of the pitching module and start of the audit module.

faqs.question: I have completed LMS. Why can I still not proceed with Pitching?
faqs.answer: Pitching access also requires the prescribed verification and agreement steps. Use the support option available on the platform or contact TEF support for technical issues.

faqs.question: I have accepted the Pitching Agreement. What should I do next?
faqs.answer: Complete OTP verification.

faqs.question: I uploaded my Business Plan Documents. Does that mean my submission is complete?
faqs.answer: No. You must submit the Business Plan after uploading the required documents.

faqs.question: I completed Window A. Why can I not see Seed Capital?
faqs.answer: Seed Capital becomes available after completing the Business Plan Document Phase. Use the support option available on the platform or contact TEF support for technical issues.

faqs.question: I uploaded my Seed Capital Documents. Do I need to click another final submission button?
faqs.answer: No separate final submission is required for Seed Capital review to begin.

faqs.question: I received a Business Plan resubmission request. Do I need to correct only the document mentioned in the feedback?
faqs.answer: No. You must resubmit the complete requested Business Plan document set.

faqs.question: I received a Seed Capital resubmission request. Do I need to upload all Seed Capital Documents again?
faqs.answer: No. You need to resubmit only the specific documents identified for correction.

faqs.question: I received resubmission remarks but do not understand what to correct. What should I refer to?
faqs.answer: Refer to the applicable remarks or feedback included in the resubmission notification.

faqs.question: My Seed Capital Documents were resubmitted, but I received another resubmission request. Is that possible?
faqs.answer: Yes. Further Seed Capital resubmission may be requested until the applicable deadline expires.

faqs.question: My Business Plan is under review. Can I submit it again on my own?
faqs.answer: No, you can only submit again when resubmission is requested.

faqs.question: My deadline is approaching. Can I continue working after the deadline?
faqs.answer: Resubmission is permitted only until the configured deadline expires, unless the applicable deadline is extended before expiry.

faqs.question: My deadline has expired. Can I still resubmit?
faqs.answer: No further resubmission action is available after expiry unless the applicable deadline was extended before expiry.

faqs.question: My Business Plan has been approved. Can it be sent for review again?
faqs.answer: Once final approval has been provided by TEF Admin, no further Business Plan re-review or resubmission applies.

sections.section: N. Difference Between Business Plan and Seed Capital Resubmission

faqs.question: Is Business Plan resubmission the same as Seed Capital resubmission?
faqs.answer: No. The two resubmission processes have different rules.

faqs.question: What is the main difference between the two resubmission processes?
faqs.answer: For Business Plan resubmission, the complete requested Business Plan document set must be resubmitted. For Seed Capital resubmission, only the specific documents identified for correction need to be resubmitted.

faqs.question: Can I select individual documents for Business Plan resubmission?
faqs.answer: No.

faqs.question: Can I select individual documents for Seed Capital resubmission?
faqs.answer: Yes.

faqs.question: Who initiates Business Plan resubmission?
faqs.answer: The applicable administrative role initiates Business Plan resubmission.

faqs.question: Who requests Seed Capital resubmission?
faqs.answer: The Intern requests Seed Capital resubmission.

faqs.question: Can Seed Capital resubmission happen more than once?
faqs.answer: Yes, until the applicable deadline expires.

faqs.question: Does Business Plan resubmission follow the review cycle again?
faqs.answer: Yes. The complete applicable external review cycle is followed again.
